root_cause.text: The `tlv_data_is_valid()` function in the Bluetooth MGMT subsystem performs type-octet inspections on `data[i + 1]` before validating that the current field length fits within the buffer boundaries, allowing an out-of-bounds read if the length byte is the last byte of the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the boundary check `if (i + cur_len >= len) return false;` being moved from the end of the loop in `tlv_data_is_valid()` to the beginning, before any of the `data[i + 1]` type checks (such as `data[i + 1] == EIR_FLAGS`) are executed.
